2a.ruling_conflict: GATE1 ruling says (4,4) is obtainable (8 pairs). Exhaustive search over ALL Huffman merge orders and tie-breaks (c,d in 1..39, sibling order left<=right) says it is NOT: with c=d=4 the multiset is {4,4,4,7,7}; any first merge of two 4s gives 8, then the next merge pairs the remaining 4 with a 7 (not with the 8), so the node b-(c,d) never forms. General bound: after merging c,d (or any), b=4 must merge with X=c+d, which needs X<=7. So c+d<=7, and c+d>=4 from b<=X, c<=d<=4. Orchestrator should re-check before changing the stored 7 to 8.
